E2-2017-T1-P1-S7.trunk: 主句：Planning documents pledged that the great legacy would be to lever a nation…away from their couches（规划文件承诺，重要遗产将是让全民离开沙发去运动）
structure: └ 宾语从句(that)：that the great legacy of the Games would be to lever a nation of sport lovers away from their couches
├ 主语：the great legacy of the Games
└ 表语不定式：to lever a nation of sport lovers away from their couches
E2-2017-T1-P1-S7.logic: pledged后接that从句说明奥运规划的承诺；从句用不定式定义所谓“重要遗产”的具体内容。
notes: lever在此作动词，意为“撬动、促使”。
lever A away from B可理解为“把A从B处拉开”。
a nation of sport lovers是集合性表达，指整个热爱体育的民族。

E2-2017-T1-P1-S18.trunk: 比较结构：There is as much joy over A as there is about B（人们为A感到的喜悦与为B感到的一样多）
structure: 主句前半：There is as much joy over a puffed-out first-timer being clapped over the line
└ 动名词复合结构：a puffed-out first-timer being clapped over the line
比较从句(as)：as there is about top talent shining
└ 动名词复合结构：top talent shining
E2-2017-T1-P1-S18.logic: as much…as…把初跑者完赛与高手出彩带来的喜悦等量比较，突出活动不只重视精英成绩。
notes: clap sb over the line指“鼓掌为某人加油，直到其越过终点”。
being clapped是被动动名词，first-timer是其逻辑主语。

E2-2017-T1-P1-S22.trunk: 条件句主干：If there is a role for government, it should be getting involved in providing common goods（如果政府有角色，就应参与提供公共资源）
structure: 条件状语从句(if)：If there is a role for government
主句：it should really be getting involved in providing common goods
破折号后具体解释providing common goods：
├ making sure there is space for playing fields and the money to pave tennis and netball courts
└ and encouraging the provision of all these activities in schools
E2-2017-T1-P1-S22.logic: if先限定政府介入的前提与边界；破折号后的两个并列动名词说明政府应提供哪些基础条件。
notes: common goods在此指公共资源或公共产品。
make sure后接两个由and连接的存在句成分：space与money。
the money to pave…中的不定式修饰money，说明资金用途。
